note: Obstacle-grammar claim types. Stack- and project-independent. Status, operand arity, and required slots live in the type definition, not in external code. Frozen for cross-corpus coverage comparison; bump vocabularyVersion on any change to a type set or a required_slots list.

NOT_ATOMIC.description: two writes that must commit together are not in a single transaction

OUTSIDE_TX.description: a side effect is dispatched after the transaction commits, with no compensation

ERROR_COLLAPSED.description: distinct failure causes collapse to one opaque value/response; handler_form is required because the literal (.catch(null) no-op vs .catch(()=>null) swallow) is what discriminates a real collapse from a false one

NO_WRITER.description: an enum/field value is declared but never assigned by any code path; scope is required because the claim quantifies over 'nowhere'

UNREACHABLE.description: a state has no inbound transition; scope is required because the claim quantifies over 'nowhere'

UNGUARDED.description: a transition lacks a required precondition

NO_AUDIT.description: an action leaves no audit record

MISSING_OWNERSHIP_CHECK.description: a resource is acted on without verifying the caller owns it (the IDOR shape)

TOCTOU.description: read-then-act without a lock; the check and the act can interleave with a concurrent writer

NO_LIFECYCLE_ENFORCEMENT.description: a lifecycle attribute (expiry, disabled, retention) is declared but never enforced; scope is required because the claim quantifies over 'nowhere'

UNBOUNDED.description: a resource has no cap, throttle, or maximum size

MISSING_FILTER.description: a query lacks a discriminating clause (evidence-level name for an unscoped destructive operation); scope is required because the claim quantifies over 'nowhere'

DIFFERENTIAL.description: two paths that should agree produce different artifacts; discharged by running both and diffing, no oracle needed

MISSING_WRITE.description: a multi-step invariant omits one required write, leaving two facets out of sync

MUTABLE_CAPTURE_ACROSS_RETRY.description: a mutable captured across a retryable transaction can desync from what was persisted

FANOUT_SHORT_CIRCUIT.description: a fan-out uses fail-fast semantics (Promise.all) so one failure drops the remainder

ORPHAN_RESOURCE.description: a resource persists with no confirmation edge reconciling it against reality

STALE_CREDENTIAL.description: a credential is expired-in-place rather than deleted, leaving hashed secrets in the store

PII_IN_LOGS.description: PII or secrets can reach logs with no documented redaction policy

NONE.description: discharge-resistant: no witness, query, or differential can be stated (code smell, preference, future-risk, or self-defeated). Membership is a mechanical test (can a discharge be stated?), not a judgement
